sloka: न च ऐकमत्ये श्रेयो अस्ति मन्त्रः सो अधम उच्यते ।तस्मात् सुमन्त्रितम् साधु भवन्तो मन्त्रि सत्तमाः ॥६-६-१५॥।।
transliteration: na ca aikamatye śreyo asti mantraḥ so adhama ucyate ।tasmāt sumantritam sādhu bhavanto mantri sattamāḥ ॥6-6-15॥।।

translations.english: "On account of that, O wise ones Think over very well, rightly of the task to be done and determine the action required by me now."
